frames.notes: Three nearby bodies; everyone stays upright. Distinct from ruck and tackle.

frames.notes: Hold so coach can inspect arms, feet and binding.

branching.question: Does A1 carry forwards or pass backwards to A2?
branching.context: Inspect where A1 looks before acting. Both options start from identical positions.
branching.watchFor: Direction of the ball and the defender response.

choices.label: Carry — D1 closes for touch

frames.name: A · Carry into the space
frames.notes: OPTION A: A1 carries. D1 tracks and closes with touch only; A2 does not receive the ball.

choices.explanation: A1 keeps the ball and carries into space. D1 tracks for touch, not a physical tackle.
choices.watchFor: Gaze, running stance and no teleport.

choices.label: Pass back — A2 catches

frames.name: B · Pass backwards to A2
frames.notes: OPTION B: A1 passes BACKWARDS to A2; D1 follows the new carrier.

choices.explanation: A1 looks at A2 then passes backwards, with A2 still behind A1.
choices.watchFor: Early gaze, ball direction, receiving hands and rewind.
